description: Allow yourself to evolve , be still and take your time #selflove #selfpreservation #trusttheprocess
transcript: You do not need every question that you have answered. Sometimes we are not prepared for the answers that we will receive. It is so important to allow ourselves to evolve and develop in a space of preparation. There is timelines. There are shifts. There are seasons for a reason. The more that we make room for doses of information, we allow ourselves to expand in maturity and prepare for what's on the other side.
